messages:
ada: did a quick SR + keyboard pass on the new Models list layout. found a few small but important issues: 1) focus indicator is only a subtle shadow so keyboard users lose track in the dense list, 2) the bulk action checkbox group isn't announced as a group, 3) the inline filter chip menu opens on click but the trigger has no aria-expanded update. attaching clip: https://assets.redwood/a11y/models-list-focus.mp4 :mag:

felix: thanks — agree these are easy regressions. for 1) let's switch to :focus-visible with a solid 3px ring that meets 3:1 on both themes. avoids mouse noise and is robust on dark backgrounds.

ruth: for the checkbox group we should add `role="group" aria-label="Bulk actions"` around the controls and ensure each checkbox has a descriptive label. some were just icons.

ada: exactly. also the check/uncheck all control needs aria-checked="mixed" logic when partially selected. currently it just toggles on/off and NVDA reads inconsistent state.

felix: for the filter chip menu trigger, add `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` pointing to the menu id. when menu opens, set focus to first menuitem and trap keyboard focus inside until closed. Escape should return focus to the trigger.

a11y-ci: automated scan: 5 violations — color-contrast (2), focus-order (1), aria-attributes (2). report: https://ci.redwood/axe/1934501234

ruth: tiny microcopy nit: change chip label from "Env" to "Environment" for screen reader clarity. keeps UI compact but helps AT users.

ada: action items: felix will open PR to add focus-visible ring + menu focus management; ruth will add role=group + aria improvements and update chip copy; I'll run axe + VoiceOver after PRs. aiming to merge by EOD.

felix: I'll include a unit test that asserts the menu trigger toggles aria-expanded and that the first menuitem receives document.activeElement on open.

ruth: I'll also add a visual snapshot for focus state in both themes so designers can sign off. small but impactful fixes :sparkles:
